title: Remove redundant test_hash.c at repo root
description:
Standalone test file at repo root duplicates coverage in lichen/tests/util/.

## File
`./test_hash.c` - tests lichen_hash_32 with manual main()

## Already covered by
`lichen/tests/util/main.c` - ZTEST(lichen_util, test_lichen_hash_32) tests the same function with the same vectors:
- hash_32(NULL, 0) = 0x811c9dc5
- hash_32("test", 4) = 0xafd071e5  
- hash_32(zeros, 32) = 0x0b2ae445

## Action
1. Verify lichen/tests/util covers the same cases
2. Delete test_hash.c
3. Check if anything references it (Makefile, CI, etc)
